headline.text: L3 ML1 metal detector failed test cards at startup; L1 S4 *4 slitter units damaged*, 9 blades replaced — neither ran product before repair.

summary: Two critical equipment failures caught before product exposure: ML1 metal detector not rejecting test cards until sensitivity adjusted; S4 slitter blades damaged mid-shift. Two ingredient holds (expired, no traceability). L1 S2 Sweco filter confirmed running without magnet.

holds.title: Two totes almonds without traceability
holds.summary: Two corn-syrup totes filled with almonds arrived with no LPNs or traceability; discarded after unable to establish origin.
holds.status: Discarded — no traceability info available after investigation with L1 and 3rd shift.

holds.title: Expired ingredient on S4
holds.summary: Angelica Perez placed expired ingredient on hold due to sour taste; disposal approved, COD in process.
holds.status: Approved for disposal, Certificate of Destruction to be created.

food_safety.title: S4 slitter blades damaged — 9 replaced
food_safety.summary: Four slitter units damaged mid-shift; maintenance replaced 9 blades total; no product ran through damaged equipment.
food_safety.status: Resolved — line disassembled, 9 blades replaced by maintenance.

food_safety.title: S2 Sweco filter has no magnet
food_safety.summary: Katya confirmed current Sweco filter setup not designed for magnet; one will be needed for Hershey production.
food_safety.status: Open — no magnet installed, acknowledged as gap for future HER runs.

food_safety.title: ML1 metal detector failed startup validation
food_safety.summary: THS metal detector set to Feastables recipe; QA test cards not rejected until maintenance adjusted sensitivity to Hershey recipe — all three cards then passed.
food_safety.status: Resolved — recipe corrected, all 3 test cards rejected, no product on hold (had not demolded yet).

food_safety.title: Caramel bucket lids missing or loose in warehouse
food_safety.summary: MDLZ tour found one caramel bucket missing lid, another with several lids lifted/loose; stored among hold items.
food_safety.status: Resolved — Justin dispatched employees to secure lids and remove open buckets.

food_safety.title: ML1 Donner belt 3 frayed
food_safety.summary: Donner belt 3 shifted north and frayed with considerable damage; maintenance replaced before product resumed.

quality.title: S2 underweight product — low almond count
quality.summary: Visual inspection revealed underweight pieces with low almond quantity; operator notified and adjusting.
quality.status: Open — operator making adjustments at end of window.

quality.title: VFFS lot-number printing defects
quality.summary: Batch printing faint and misplaced every ~20 bags; line paused, defective pouches pulled, issue resolved on new film roll.
quality.status: Resolved — defective pouches removed, new roll printing correctly.

sanitation.title: Truffle Cavannas left very dirty by 3rd shift
sanitation.summary: 1st shift found Cavannas extremely dirty with significant chocolate buildup on Bottomer and Enrober mesh; paused to clean and reheat.
sanitation.status: Resolved — machines cleaned, reheat completed, production resumed.

sanitation.title: Almonds on floor after sorting
sanitation.summary: Brandon Lance found almonds on floor on other side of curtain after sorting shift; Alex and Jeffrey to ensure cleanup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — supervisor sent to clean immediately.

opportunities.text: Consider adding slitter blade inspection to S4 startup checklist — today's damaged blades and 9-blade replacement echo the need for pre-shift verification of food-contact cutting surfaces.
Require LPN verification before moving ingredient totes between plants — today's two almond totes arrived with no labels and had to be discarded for lack of traceability.
Review metal-detector recipe verification procedure for ML1 — today's startup caught wrong recipe (Feastables vs. Hershey) only when test cards failed to reject.
Add Cavanna cleanliness check to Truffle end-of-shift signoff — 1st shift lost production time cleaning heavy chocolate buildup left by 3rd.
